XSUP Auditor & KCS Generator

Install the complete tool as a self-contained Chrome bookmark. No TACopilot backend hosting or external JavaScript hosting is required.
Run XSUP RetrospectiveEnter one or more XSUP IDs. Runs the product-specific retrospective field review and then Knowledge generation when applicable.
Generate KCSEnter an XSUP ID or 8-digit SFDC case number. Skips the retrospective field-review prompt and runs TACO/evidence, KCS generation, independent quality review, automatic checks, optional repair and human review.
